label_entries.identity_note: Calculation scenario: pure anhydrous L-lysine monohydrochloride, 100% assay. Free lysine = salt mass × 146.19/182.65; chloride = salt mass × 35.45/182.65. Supplier assay/hydrate not verified; lysine is not equated with protein.
